mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_logs ( project_id, pattern_page, content, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{patternPage}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT work_log_id AS workLogId, project_id AS projectId, pattern_page AS patternPage, content, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
FROM work_logs
WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
ORDER BY created_at ASC, work_log_id ASC
